tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Console ground: page background, letterbox around the stage. Shipped value.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Drawers, the command rail and docked panels. Shipped value.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, controls, dialogs, floating HUD clusters over the stage.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Dialog and card headers, hover fill on quiet controls, readout wells.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Segmented-tab track, slider track, pressed fill.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind #threeCanvasHost (flat; replaces the decorative radial gradient #f8fafc→#eaedf1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside panels and between rows. Decorative only — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outer edge of drawers, dialogs, cards and HUD clusters.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Border of every interactive control (button, chip, input, pill). ≥3:1 on surface and panel in every theme (new: shipped controls used line-strong at 1.65:1).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and numerals on bg, panel, surface, surface-2. Shipped value (day).

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions, step explanations on any surface.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Captions, eyebrows, units on any surface. Day darkened from #6a7277 (4.18:1 on bg) to pass 4.5:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. Ink, so it never reads as a signal colour.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal backdrop (shipped day value, without the blur).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, selected tab text, slider fill, current-step marker. Shipped value (day).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover / pressed fill of accent controls.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected background: active chip, active rail item, current LOTO step card.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Border of selected chips and the current-step card.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Teal text on accent-tint (selected chip label, link text).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Dark in Night watch because the accent is lightened there.

tokens.name: spotlight
tokens.usage: Training-mode current-step ring. Always paired with the "Next" tag — never colour alone.

tokens.name: spotlight-halo
tokens.usage: Soft outer halo of the spotlight pulse.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Castell keys, key box, tutorial "look here" hints, CAD title block rule. Day darkened from #8f6519 (4.45:1 on brass-tint).

tokens.name: brass-tint
tokens.usage: Key chip in hand, hint box background. Shipped value (day).

tokens.name: brass-line
tokens.usage: Border of key chips and hint boxes.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: LIVE / energized / DANGER / breaker CLOSED [I]. Marks, dots, fills, Close button. Shipped value (day).

tokens.name: live-tint
tokens.usage: Background of live badges and live bus cards.

tokens.name: live-line
tokens.usage: Border of live badges and danger-quiet buttons.

tokens.name: live-ink
tokens.usage: Live text on live-tint or surface. ≥7:1 (critical status).

tokens.name: on-live
tokens.usage: Text on a solid live fill.

tokens.name: safe
tokens.usage: Safe / DEAD-proven / breaker OPEN [O] / item done. Marks, Trip button. Shipped value (day).

tokens.name: safe-tint
tokens.usage: Background of safe badges, equipped PPE rows, completed steps.

tokens.name: safe-line
tokens.usage: Border of safe badges and completed steps.

tokens.name: safe-ink
tokens.usage: Safe text on safe-tint or surface. ≥7:1.

tokens.name: on-safe
tokens.usage: Text on a solid safe fill.

tokens.name: earth
tokens.usage: EARTHED: earth switch EK6 closed, CME applied, earth tag. Marks and fills. Shipped value; as text on earth-tint it is 4.44:1 — use earth-ink for text.

tokens.name: earth-tint
tokens.usage: Background of earthed badges; Tier 1 interlock toast.

tokens.name: earth-line
tokens.usage: Border of earthed badges and the Tier 1 toast.

tokens.name: earth-ink
tokens.usage: Earth / Tier 1 text on earth-tint or surface. ≥7:1.

tokens.name: on-earth
tokens.usage: Text on a solid earth fill.

tokens.name: test
tokens.usage: TEST position, Sanction-for-Test, Megger, stored charge. Shipped value (day).

tokens.name: test-tint
tokens.usage: Background of test badges and the Megger readout well.

tokens.name: test-line
tokens.usage: Border of test badges and test buttons.

tokens.name: test-ink
tokens.usage: Test text on test-tint or surface. ≥7:1.

tokens.name: on-test
tokens.usage: Text on a solid test fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information, selected tool, info toasts. Shipped value (day).

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Background of info toasts and the selected tool tile.

tokens.name: info-line
tokens.usage: Border of info toasts and selected tool tile.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Info text on info-tint or surface.

tokens.name: dead
tokens.usage: De-energized / unknown marks (bus card bar, CVI dot off). Marks only, ≥3:1 on surface and surface-2; never text. Day darkened from #8a9196 (2.88:1 on surface-2).

tokens.name: hazard-ground
tokens.usage: Arc-flash banner and NFPA 70E report background (dark in every theme, shipped value).

tokens.name: hazard-yellow
tokens.usage: ISO 7010 W012 sign field, hazard kicker text, NFPA header strip. Only during a Tier 2 event.

tokens.name: hazard-red
tokens.usage: Arc-flash banner border and vignette edge. Only during a Tier 2 event.

tokens.name: hazard-stripe-a
tokens.usage: Hazard stripe red band (#hazardPattern). Live compartments and back-feed only.

tokens.name: hazard-stripe-b
tokens.usage: Hazard stripe yellow band (#hazardPattern).

tokens.name: on-hazard
tokens.usage: Text on hazard-ground.

tokens.name: on-hazard-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on hazard-ground (reason line).

tokens.name: bay-c1
tokens.usage: C1 DG1 — generator incomer identity: pill dot, inspector edge, callout chip. Shipped value (day).

tokens.name: bay-c2
tokens.usage: C2 BT1 — bus-tie identity.

tokens.name: bay-c3
tokens.usage: C3 BT-M1 — bow thruster feeder identity (default active bay). White chip text on it is 4.497:1 in Day — set chip codes bold (≥14px bold counts as large) or use the projector theme.

tokens.name: bay-c4
tokens.usage: C4 TR1-HV — transformer HV feeder identity.

tokens.name: bay-c5
tokens.usage: C5 ACB-TR1-LV — 440 V ACB identity.

tokens.name: cat-enclosure
tokens.usage: SK CF AR FD — enclosure parts: chip square, callout code fill.

tokens.name: cat-control
tokens.usage: LD PR AX — control parts.

tokens.name: cat-mechanism
tokens.usage: RL TC SD MF — mechanism parts.

tokens.name: cat-interrupter
tokens.usage: EP VI TL — interrupter parts.

tokens.name: cat-safety
tokens.usage: SS SP — safety parts (shutters, spouts). Shipped Day value carries white code text at 4.35:1 — keep codes 14px bold; Projector passes.

tokens.name: cat-earthing
tokens.usage: ES — earthing parts.

tokens.name: cat-power
tokens.usage: BB CT — power-path parts.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Bay Operator heading, current LOTO step title.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Group headings inside drawers and the Bay Operator.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Trip the VCB and rack the truck to DISCONNECTED 0/20.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: The minimum size on desktop: tooltips, captions, step descriptions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button, chip, tab and rail labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels above values. Replaces the shipped 10.5–11.5px eyebrows. Never below 13px.

styles.name: readout-xl
styles.usage: Megger IR / PI, exam timer, debrief score.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Bay voltage, truck turns, stored charge.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Telemetry values, state labels inside indicators.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Permit codes, part codes, bay codes, units next to readouts.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code chips inside running text (tutorial, FAQ).

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudge, badge inner gap.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between segmented tabs.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in a row; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card and HUD-cluster padding; gap between rows in a group.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Drawer and dialog padding; gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gutter between the stage edge and floating clusters.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing in drawers and the briefing screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Dialog body padding in Presentation density; debrief columns.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Briefing / debrief outer margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, key chips, part chips, CAD title block (shipped r-sm).

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tool tiles, toasts (shipped r).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, HUD clusters, drawers, dialogs (shipped r-lg).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Bay pills, segmented tracks, the plant-state chip.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting controls and cards (shipped day value).

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Floating HUD clusters, toasts, popovers over the stage (shipped day value).

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Drawers and modal dialogs (shipped day value).

size.note: Control heights, touch targets and the workspace frame.

tokens.name: control-xs
tokens.usage: Dense desktop chips in the CAD cluster only (never on touch).

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons on desktop (Default density).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Standard buttons; Bay Operator actions on desktop.

tokens.name: control-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum target for every control under (pointer: coarse) and in Presentation density.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: Slim top bar height.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Command rail width (icons + 12px labels).

tokens.name: drawer-w
tokens.usage: Tools / PPE / Megger / Parts / Help drawer width on desktop.

tokens.name: operator-w
tokens.usage: Bay Operator + LOTO stepper column (floating over the stage edge).

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Default icon size in controls (24px viewBox sprite).

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Rail icons and state-indicator glyphs.

duration.note: Motion durations. UI motion never exceeds dur-base; state changes are instant.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Breaker, earth switch, key and padlock state changes — always instant.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, tooltip in, chip toggle.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Drawer slide, popover, toast in. The ceiling for UI motion.

tokens.name: dur-pulse
tokens.usage: One cycle of the Training-mode spotlight pulse.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Drawers, popovers, toasts.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Elements leaving (drawer close, toast out).

zIndex.note: Stacking order of the full-bleed stage layers and overlays.

tokens.name: z-stage
tokens.usage: #threeCanvasHost.

tokens.name: z-callout
tokens.usage: Callout layer (#calloutLayer), CAD title block.

tokens.name: z-hud
tokens.usage: Floating clusters over the stage (Bay Operator, camera cluster, stepper).

tokens.name: z-vignette
tokens.usage: Arc-flash vignette (#arcFlashVignette).

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Drawers and the command rail.

tokens.name: z-banner
tokens.usage: Arc-flash HUD banner (#arcFlashHudBanner).

tokens.name: z-toast

tokens.name: z-tooltip
